description: Settings for the crucible coding agent. Formats are unstable while the version is 0.0.x: any key here may be renamed or removed in any release, with no deprecation period.

env.description: Environment variables for the commands crucible runs. A checked-in file may set only crucible's own CRUCIBLE_CODE_ names

color.description: Whether to dim the prompt: auto follows the terminal and NO_COLOR, always and never override it

toolDetail.description: How much of a tool call and its result one line shows

providers.description: Per-provider defaults, keyed by provider name

apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding this provider's API key — the name, never the key

model.description: The model to ask when --model does not name one

title: crucible configuration
